name: Redline / Typographic Studio
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: ONE original, highly refined personal portfolio HERO / LANDING VIEWPORT screenshot, landscape 1536x1024. Actual website flat and edge-to-edge, not a device/browser/presentation mockup.
Subject: Zohaib Haider, 'Full-stack AI Engineer'. Clear supporting scope 'Agentic AI · Full-stack products · Payment systems'. This is the portfolio of a software engineer with two years of work, not an agency, fashion brand or AI SaaS.
Input image: identity reference, his actual source photo. Use the SAME recognizable man, swept dark hair, moustache/light beard, black suit, white shirt and tie. NO GLASSES, no new person, no glamour redesign, no mascot. Preserve natural proportions and face. A thoughtful photo crop or monochrome treatment is permitted.
Latest brief: a stylish, distinctive, professional hero with enough breathing room. Avoid an overloaded first page. Show only name, role, one concise introduction, primary action, navigation and a visual idea. Detailed skills, stack, project descriptions and workflow diagrams belong BELOW the hero. A very small '2+ years building real products' line is allowed but not a big stat block.
Four real projects, only when a small project index is specified: OpsPilot — AI incident investigation; HR Intelligence — Intercom AI support assistant; DSP — driving school marketplace with Stripe Connect; RTA Marketing — automotive CRM and vehicle data. Do not portray HR Intelligence as recruitment or RTA as fintech. No invented numbers or claims.
Quality target: truly art-directed original portfolio website, beautiful contemporary typography, confident visual hierarchy, polished composition. Elegant and readable rather than cluttered. Each design in this series has its OWN composition, typography and palette. Static visual concept of future 3D/motion.
Avoid: basic text-left/photo-right landing template, white centered resume with a small code-bracket decoration, chrome ribbons, giant italic serif luxury headings, glowing brain/orb, glass dashboards on marble plinths, toy control panels, origami villages, dense capability maps, skill badge walls, fake awards/clients/revenue, watermarks. Do not fill empty space with decorations.
A bold red-and-ivory creative engineering portfolio with impeccable typographic composition, matte dimensional lettering and a natural portrait. Colors warm ivory #F2EEE8, ink #191A18, controlled vermilion #D74B39. Clean narrow modern grotesk with careful medium weight, not serif and not bulky cartoon type.
Layout is a full-width editorial COVER, not columns. A slim header reads 'ZH / ZOHAIB HAIDER', 'WORK / ABOUT / CONTACT ↗'. A huge but beautifully spaced two-line name 'ZOHAIB' and 'HAIDER' runs across the FULL viewport, about 105px, one line near upper third and one near lower third. The name is the spatial structure, not a meaningless slogan. Parts of the letters have subtle 3D extrusion and a slight stagger in depth, all matte dark ink with soft shadows. A large vertical black-and-white crop of the SAME man's portrait intersects the gap BETWEEN the name lines, positioned about 40% from left, 280px wide, extending naturally downward, face unobscured. One restrained red vertical strip creates a precise compositional anchor behind photo, no flashy glow.
The clear flat role 'Full-stack AI Engineer' sits in the upper-right NEGATIVE SPACE beside the letter composition, with a tiny supporting 'Agentic AI · Full-stack products · Payment systems'. Under the lower name baseline, a short simple line 'I build the intelligence—and the software around it.' and underlined 'Explore the work ↘'. These are integrated into the typographic grid, not a standalone text column. Tiny '2+ years building real products' at lower-left, contact text at lower-right. Bottom 12% begins a thin offwhite project index with the four correct names only, clean rules, no dense panels.
Impeccable negative-space pockets, photograph feels editorial and personal, beautiful typography and matte physical depth. Future motion cue: a tiny 'SCROLL / REVEAL THE WORK' at side, as letters and portrait could slide through planes. Professional, striking, controlled. No random chrome asterisk, no giant serif, no busy collage.

An exceptionally elegant cinematic MONOCHROME portrait-led engineering portfolio. Deep charcoal #111313, warm gray #A5AAA6, offwhite #EDEFEA and one small pale-green #BFCFB5 accent. Exquisite humanist sans-serif, medium-weight role, calm typography, no enormous decorative slogan.

Sophisticated personal presence, confident and understated, like an architect's photographic portfolio adapted to a real AI engineer. Bottom 12% nearwhite clean project index, all four correct project names, minimal thin rules. Elegant scale contrasts, striking 3D role identity, few elements and lots of breathing room. No code-bracket ornaments, no diagrams, no technology logos, no poster-like clutter.
